pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark brown regions with soft-edged pixel gradients. The flank patches exhibit smaller, more diverse shapes with rounded vertices, while patches on the visible neck section are larger and more rectangular.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored pathways forming a continuous topological graph. The network features frequent three-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, tapering slightly at some junctions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette formed by short, stiff hair along the neck's dorsal line.
